This [[file:glossary.org::#term/protocol][storage decorator]] forwards non-versioned entities unchanged. For versioned entities it resolves reads in the current branch and appends [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-view][version rows]] on writes. Follow the delegated functions to inspect each operation separately.

* 3. create-entity-versioned!
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: versioning/create-entity-versioned!
:FILE: src/graphden/versioning/storage/core.clj
:LINE: 242
:MINS: 6.0
:END:

Creates an [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-view][identity row]] and a [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-view][version row]], accounting for an existing deterministic ID. Function names and list positions must be unique in the [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-view][resolved branch view]], so their checks and writes use an [[file:glossary.org::#term/advisory-lock][advisory lock]]. A global table constraint would incorrectly reject legitimate differences between branches.

Checks list-item position uniqueness in the [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-view][resolved branch view]]. Both ordinary writes and merges use this check. A database constraint across all branches would prevent legitimate divergence; the write path therefore serializes the branch-specific check and write with an [[file:glossary.org::#term/advisory-lock][advisory lock]]. Function-name uniqueness uses the same approach.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/versioning/storage/uniqueness.clj::(defn check-list-item-position-collisions!][src/graphden/versioning/storage/uniqueness.clj:27]]

:LINE: 63
:MINS: 3.5

Decides which [[file:glossary.org::#term/branch-view][identity rows]] may be physically deleted. Ordinary user deletion writes a [[file:glossary.org::#term/tombstone][tombstone]]; synchronization and rollback sometimes need physical deletion. An identity may be removed only when no other branch keeps a version and no child identity still references it, preventing dangling identities without deleting another branch's data.

- source :: [[file:../../../src/graphden/versioning/storage/purge.clj::(defn purgeable-identity-ids][src/graphden/versioning/storage/purge.clj:63]]

Increments the graph [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][epoch]] before a graph-changing write. The branch router checks this counter when retrieving a context, so it can detect missed invalidations even when a request was interrupted or a notification was lost. Immediate cache updates and notifications reduce refresh latency.

Checks graph [[file:glossary.org::#term/invalidation][epochs]] since the context's last recorded position and distinguishes applied, notified, in-progress, and missed changes. Missed changes trigger a background rebuild for the base context and eviction of other cached branch contexts, which rebuild on demand.
